goal: To enable therapists to schedule appointments with clients while ensuring complete client anonymity during notifications.
core_capabilities: Schedule appointments between therapists and clients
Send notifications (emails, SMS, etc.) to therapists without revealing client identity
Provide a calendar view for therapists to manage appointments
Allow clients to book/cancel appointments anonymously
assumptions: All therapists are registered users of the system.
The system must comply with privacy and confidentiality regulations regarding client data.
Therapists are responsible for managing their availability in the system.
open_questions: What specific modes of notification (emails, SMS, etc.) are required?
How will the system authenticate clients while maintaining anonymity?
Are there any specific regulations that need to be adhered to in terms of client data security?
